_comment: Merge the UserPromptSubmit entry below into ~/.claude/settings.json.
If you already have a `hooks` key, add this object to the existing
UserPromptSubmit array rather than replacing it -- Claude Code runs every
entry in the array, so several hooks coexist happily.
`command` assumes roleplay-roll is on PATH. If it isn't, use an absolute
path to the symlink or to roleplay/bin/roleplay-roll directly; the script
resolves its own roster either way.
Keys beginning with _ are not read by Claude Code, so this block is safe to
leave in place -- but there is no reason to copy it across.
